public_definitions: The goal is to review the regional air-quality dashboard and select the follow-up route that best matches the overall dashboard trend for the 2018-2023 planning case.
The chart is titled 'Increasing Regional Air Quality Recovery from 2018 to 2023'.
The x-axis represents years from 2018 to 2023.

The primary field to be selected is 'Regional air-quality handling route' with three options: 'Route the record to routine air-quality recovery monitoring', 'Route the record to air-quality recovery expansion follow-up', or 'Route the record to air-quality deterioration response review'.
